---
title: "MSMS"
---

MSMS computes molecular surfaces. It is free for academic research; commercial use needs a license (contact [Dr. Michel Sanner](mailto:sanner@scripps.edu)). MSMS is not open source.

::: {.callout-note}
This page is being moved from the CCSB website. Until then, overview, downloads, documentation
and tutorials are at **[ccsb.scripps.edu/msms](https://ccsb.scripps.edu/msms/)**.
:::
